verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a package of skills installed into external agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Its Ralph loop and ledger skills structure task execution, but the AI doing the work is the host agent, not an assistant built into the product. That is a host-platform capability, so it earns no credit, and nothing in the evidence shows YYLO itself ships a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
